Learn the game,
one task at a time.

Short, task-based guides for what you can do in the game today. Every key, number and recipe is traced to the game's source code, and planned features stay marked as planned.

02 / NOT WRITTEN YET

Still on the list.

These guides are next, in the order players need them. Each waits on a source check and, where noted, on screenshots from a disposable headless session.

  1. Maps and finding your way home Needs screenshots

    Players lose builds after travel; markers, journal places and the destination beacon already help.

  2. Install, update and where your worlds live Ready to write

    Reinstalling is the only update path and Continue reopens the default world, so players need clear file locations.

  3. Building basics and creative tools Needs screenshots

    Placement, half-metre detail, brushes and undo are the core of creative play.

  4. Sailing a boat Needs screenshots

    Wind, tacking and the helm controls are not obvious without a walkthrough.

  5. Content packs and what each adds Needs screenshots

    Six packs change the world in different ways, and some changes are kept in the save.

  6. Hunting, weapons and animals Ready to write

    Animals never attack; hunting is the renewable food source and the bow and rifle have specific controls.

  7. Settings and performance Needs screenshots

    Shader tier, horizon and frame limit decide smoothness on laptops; measured guidance follows in the performance study.

  8. Fixing startup, sound and save problems Ready to write

    Fatal errors currently appear only in a terminal, so players need to know where logs and saves are.

  9. Iron Skies & Tracks vehicles Ready to write

    Each vehicle type has its own keys, and the fighter keys in the game README are wrong.

  10. Study Grove focus timer Needs screenshots

    An owner-requested study mode with its own controls and backdrops.

  11. Not in the game yet Waiting for the feature

    One honest page answers the common “is this in the game?” questions without inventing details.
